goal: Prove the project is safe and operational for public launch

phases.name: DNS And Routing
tasks: Confirm no port conflict with the 4 existing apps on the VPS
Assign unique internal ports for backend and admin

phases.name: Server Runtime Setup
tasks: Install or verify Node.js LTS and pnpm/npm compatibility
Install and configure PM2 or systemd services
Create application directories, log directories, and uploads directory
Set correct file permissions for uploads and runtime logs

phases.name: Environment Variables
tasks: Create backend production env file with DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, CORS_ORIGINS, SMTP, AFS, BACKEND_PUBLIC_URL
Create admin production env file with NEXTAUTH_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_API_BASE_URL
Create mobile production env values with EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL
Verify secrets are strong and not reused from development

phases.name: Database Verification
tasks: Verify all required tables exist including raw SQL referenced tables
Verify governorates, areas, settings, packages, and auth tables are populated as needed

phases.name: Build And Start
tasks: Verify health endpoint and API reachability through Nginx

phases.name: SSL And Security
tasks: Issue SSL certificates for all domains
Rotate server password because it was exposed in chat
Prefer SSH keys and disable password login if possible

phases.name: Critical Business Flow Testing
tasks: Create and edit company property with image upload
Run payment return and callback test

hardBlockers: Production SMTP is not yet proven
Production AFS is not yet proven
Live database schema parity is not yet proven
Real server runtime has not yet been validated
Browser-side admin token handling still needs hardening
definitionOfReady: All services start cleanly after reboot
HTTPS works on web, admin, and api
Database schema is complete and verified
AFS payment flow succeeds and callback updates records
Admin login, company login, and individual login all work
Rollback procedure is documented and tested
